heading: EXT. CABLE CAR GONDOLA, MIDWAY OVER ALPINE GORGE - NIGHT

units.text: EXT. CABLE CAR GONDOLA, MIDWAY OVER ALPINE GORGE - NIGHT
A tiny glass cabin dangling from a single cable above a black abyss.
Wind groans through the steel.
Snow beads on the windows.
Inside, four passengers sit pressed together on cold benches, lit by a flickering emergency strip.
MAGNUS HALVORSEN, fifties, a ski instructor in a red parka, grips the safety rail.
SOLEDAD "SOL" ARRIAGA, thirties, a nurse in a cardigan, kneels beside the seat where PRISCILLA TRENT, seventies, in a fur-trimmed coat, sits very pale.
JIN-HO PARK, twenties, a backpacker, holds a dead phone in both hands.
Stay calm. They'll restart the motor in the next few minutes.
units.name: MAGNUS

units.text: You said that twenty minutes ago, Magnus.
units.name: SOL

units.text: And I'll say it again.
units.name: MAGNUS

units.text: Is it moving?
units.name: JIN-HO

units.text: Everything's moving, dear. We're on a string.
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: Mrs. Trent, look at me. Breathe through your nose.
units.name: SOL

units.text: I am breathing, Soledad.
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: Slower, then.
units.name: SOL

units.text: The gondola lurches.
Everyone grabs something.
Jin-ho slides across the bench into Magnus, and Magnus catches him by the front of his jacket.
Sorry, sorry --
units.name: JIN-HO

units.text: Sit. Hold the bar.
units.name: MAGNUS

units.text: A sharp metallic crack from the cable above.
The cabin drops three feet, swings, and slams to a halt.
Priscilla cries out.
Sol throws her arms around her.
Magnus and Jin-ho fall together against the glass and for a moment all four are a heap of coats, elbows, gasps.
Everyone, don't move!
units.name: MAGNUS

units.text: No one does.
The cabin sways, slowly, like a pendulum losing its argument.
Jin-ho, can you reach the hatch?
units.name: SOL

units.text: It's over my head.
units.name: JIN-HO

units.text: Magnus can lift you.
units.name: SOL

units.text: Not with this rope between my --
units.name: MAGNUS

units.text: Magnus Halvorsen, you will lift that boy.
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: A beat.
Magnus nods.
He braces his boots against the bench and cups his hands.
Jin-ho steps up, one knee on Magnus's palms, and fumbles at the roof hatch.
It resists.
He pounds it with his fist, and it pops open, and a rope ladder tumbles down into the cabin from a rescue helicopter's lamp, white and blinding.
Priscilla! Priscilla, look!
units.name: SOL

units.text: I see it, dear. I'm not blind.
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: Magnus bursts into tears.
